notes.title: First Major Update
notes.content:
Hey, everybody! It's been almost a month since we launched, and we're extremely glad for all the support you gave to this project <3 I wanted to give you guys an update on what's on the horizon and what you should be expecting in the coming weeks as far as Where Thoughts Go is concerned.

[b]Also, please join us on Discord to be part of our community! More active conversations going on there: [/b]https://discordapp.com/invite/vbJm76d

We've been receiving a ton of in-game thoughts from you guys and it's been so joyous to hear them all <3 Practically no instances of trolling behavior, which really showcases what a healthy community you all are. We've been using this opportunity to review the best way to get thoughts into the system quickly, so if you've been playing regularly you probably started to find some messages more than once as you approach the ceiling of the available content - that'll be fixed in the next update, which will make all the other thoughts available.

While we had a smooth launch, we know that Prologue isn't perfect (yet!). There's one or two bugs that need to be worked out - nothing game-breaking (mainly stutters in one chapter), but we want the smoothest experience possible for everyone, so we'll be rolling out fixes for that as well.

So for the next update: performance improvements, bug fixes and a ton more thoughts. All within the next 2 weeks (currently working on another surprise for you all that I'll be revealing next week!)

So yes, that's all. Thank you for your support and much love to you <3

Lucas
